shared_elements: relief carving in low/raised relief on a vertical stone surface
animal or animal-derived form rendered in relief
arm/hand and limb rendered on a surface
justification: Both show figural relief carving including animal forms and depicted arms/hands, but A is a naturalistic narrative procession of human tribute-bearers leading a two-humped camel beneath a band of rosettes, while B is a single monolithic pillar with a small schematic animal in high relief above a slender arm and splayed hand curving around the shaft. The relationships, arrangement and conventions of depiction (narrative frieze in profile versus isolated anthropomorphic monolith) share nothing specific.
